rubric.role_summary: Staff-level backend engineering for large-scale distributed systems, building and operating scalable, multi-tenant services and an enterprise offering spanning on-premise and dedicated cloud deployments.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Staff-level backend engineering for large-scale distributed systems, building and operating scalable, multi-tenant services and an enterprise offering spanning on-premise and dedicated cloud deployments.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience designing large-scale distributed systems.
- Operational experience in large-scale distributed systems environments.
- Experience developing highly concurrent systems.
- Experience with Elasticsearch or ClickHouse.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Familiarity with Go or other similar languages.
- Experience with infrastructure environments.
- Rich experience as an “Arranger” and/or “Builder/Enhancer” in large-scale distributed systems design, including reliability and scalability.
- Demonstrated experience writing concurrent code in production at an Advanced or Expert level.
- Knowledge and experience of reliability.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Seattle area, Washington; San Francisco Bay Area, California; United States (Remote). Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
